query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-20T10:40:06Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T10:40:06Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND process.name == "sshd"
        AND event.outcome == "success"
        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.16"
| STATS accepted_count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY user.name, source.ip, auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey", message LIKE "*password*", "password", message LIKE "*certificate*", "certificate", "unknown")
| SORT accepted_count DESC
